info.title: Company Logo API
info.description: Get any company's logo and icon from its domain: best square icon at your size, full logo, brand color and site name, or the image itself. Initials fallback. Replacement for the retired Clearbit Logo API.

get.summary: Logo and icon for a domain

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Preferred icon size in px, 16-1024 (default 128): returns the smallest icon at or above it

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: json (default: URLs, sizes, sources, brand color, name) or image (the image bytes, ready for )

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: icon (square brand mark, default) or logo (full logo, often a wordmark)

parameters.name: fallback
parameters.description: initials (default: an SVG initials avatar when no logo exists) or none (404)
